_comment: Ticket 09 saturation ramp — SIZE A: c7i.xlarge (4 vCPU, 3 workers), today's staging/prod shape.
The steps array is IDENTICAL to config.ramp-sizeB-c7i-2xlarge.json — comparability is the whole
point (ticket 09). Only expectedWorkers and roomPrefix differ between the two files.
target.url is a placeholder — re-derive the live staging IP per the runbook step 0 and patch
on-box with jq before every campaign (the checked-in IP goes stale on every instance refresh).
holdSeconds 600 = SLO doc §7.0 rule 4 minimum; recorder.mjs computeKnee ignores shorter steps.
stopOnFail true so the ramp halts at the knee instead of burning hours past it.
fleet.userIdBase DELIBERATELY ABSENT — see config.loadgen-2x10.json comment (setting it pins
every bot to one JWT id).
Loadgen host must be c7i.8xlarge: the last step runs ~2040 bots with real Opus decode at a
measured ~0.0105 vCPU/bot — ~67% of 32 vCPU, just inside the 70% generator-headroom rule
(ticket 09 Trap 1). Anything smaller makes the top steps invalid data points.
Schedule v3 (2026-08-14): v1 (4x10 .. 18x45) all-PASSED at 12% host CPU — nowhere near the
knee. v2 held rooms at 20 and grew only listeners — VOID at step 1, because a listener-only
step fires no audio:produce and G1 correctly fails (SLO doc §7.5 note). v3 grows BOTH: every
step adds 2 rooms (so speakers keep producing join/produce events in the window) and tops out
at 30x68 = ~2100 bots / ~4080 consumers — the most the 32-vCPU spot quota lets one generator
drive at 70% headroom. If this finds no knee, record capacity as a floor, not a knee.
